name: T-strap
summary: A shoe strap in the shape of a T: one strap runs over the instep and one runs down the vamp to the toe.
how: Run a vertical strap from the vamp to the instep strap.
Close the instep strap with a button or a buckle at the side.
Cut the vamp low so that the T shows.

origin.note: The T-strap becomes the standard dance shoe of the 1920s.

adoptions.via: The T-strap holds the foot in the Charleston and gives the Deco shoe its graphic line.
